description: This file contains C source code implementing token parsing functions for AT command responses, including functions for starting tokenization, skipping whitespace, parsing integers, booleans, and strings, as well as managing token streams.

methods.name: at_tok_start
methods.description: Initializes token parsing by locating the colon character in the response string and advancing the pointer.

methods.name: skipNextComma
methods.description: Advances the pointer past the next comma in the response string.

methods.name: at_tok_nextint
methods.description: Parses the next integer token in the response string, assuming base 10.

methods.name: at_tok_nexthexint
methods.description: Parses the next hexadecimal integer token in the response string.

methods.name: at_tok_nextbool
methods.description: Parses the next token as a boolean (0 or 1).

methods.name: at_tok_nextstr
methods.description: Extracts the next string token from the response.

methods.name: at_tok_hasmore
methods.description: Checks if there are more tokens to parse.
